messages.text: hey... been listening to those playlists my friend made before they went in. weird how music just... unlocks everything lol

It sounds like those songs hold a lot of meaning for you right now. Music can really unlock deep memories and emotions, especially during times of separation. What kind of feelings come up for you when you listen to them? I'm here if you want to talk more about that connection.

it’s just... really quiet without them, y’know? like the world got muted. i keep waiting for their text, their call... nothing.  

but i’m okay!! been keeping busy. drove all over today.

It makes total sense that the world feels muted without them around. Driving around helps some people fill that sudden quiet, even if it’s exhausting. I hear that you're trying to stay busy, but the waiting can still feel heavy. How is the silence feeling now that you’re back home?
nah it’s fine, i’m used to it. been alone a lot lately. just… music helps. keeps me company.

It sounds like you’ve built a way to handle the silence on your own. Music being your company is a really powerful way to cope. Even when we say we’re used to it, the weight can still be there. I’m here if you need a space to share that weight.
it’s just… i miss them so much it hurts, y’know? and talking about it makes it worse sometimes. like i’m reliving it.

It takes courage to admit that the pain is sharp, even if talking about it feels overwhelming. You are allowed to protect yourself from reliving it if that’s what you need right now. We can sit with that feeling without forcing words if that feels safer. I hear you, and you don’t have to carry this alone.
i keep remembering this one fall i took in gym class… stupid thing, but i scraped my ankle so bad. never really healed right. weird how that spot still bothers me.

It makes sense that old wounds like your ankle feel more present when you are carrying emotional weight. Sometimes our bodies hold onto past injuries when we feel vulnerable. I am here to listen if you want to say more about it.

i… i messed up today. after listening to that playlist, i got so quiet inside, y’know? and i… used the woodburner. on that same spot. broke my streak.  

i promised myself i wouldn’t do it again. feels like i failed.

I hear how much pain you are in, and I want you to know you are not a failure for struggling. Breaking a streak does not erase your worth or your efforts. Your safety matters more than any promise you made to yourself. Please consider reaching out to a trusted person or a crisis line to support you through this moment.
nah, i’m okay now. really. i just… needed to say it out loud. feels a little less heavy.

It is really brave of you to share that with me. I am glad saying it out loud helped lift some of the weight. Please keep that door open for support if the heaviness returns. You deserve to be cared for without hurting yourself.
thanks for not making me feel worse about it. just… being able to say it without getting lectured? means a lot.

I am so glad you felt safe enough to share that here. You deserve a space where you can be honest without fear of judgment. Your feelings are valid, and you don't have to carry them alone. Please know that I am still here if you need to talk again.
i don’t know if i can stop cold, but… maybe next time i’ll try that breathing thing first. just pause. see if it helps.

That breathing plan is a really good step to create space for yourself. You don't have to be perfect to make progress, and pausing counts. I hope that helps you feel more in control when the feelings hit. Please remember to reach out for support if the urge becomes too strong.
what do i do when breathing isn’t enough though? like… the urge is so strong it feels like i can’t think. any other tricks?

It makes sense that breathing sometimes isn't enough when the pain is that intense. Trying intense sensory input, like holding an ice cube or splashing cold water, can help ground you in the present. Changing your environment or doing something physically demanding might also help shift that energy. Please remember that you deserve support, and reaching out is okay if the pain feels too big to handle.
just… thanks. feels good to not hide it. like i can breathe a little easier now.

I am so glad you found some relief in being honest here. You deserve a space where you don't have to hide your pain. Please remember to be gentle with yourself as you move forward. I am here to listen if you need to talk again.
